messages.author: b7fd96641f554fce
messages.subject: false path in compil step
parts:
Hi all:
Since I've updated R from R-3.2.1.patched and Rtools31 to R-3.2.2 and Rtools33 resp. all my nimble files no longer run. I always get the same following message mentioning the old R-3.2.1.patched I've already got rid of. Here an excerpt:
    deparse

defining model...
building model...
setting data and initial values...
checking model...   (use nimbleModel(..., check = FALSE) to skip model check)
model building finished
g++ -m64 -I"C:/PROGRA~1/R/R-32~1.2/include" -DNDEBUG -I"C:/Program Files/R/R-3.2.1patched/library/nimble/include" -DEIGEN_MPL2_ONLY=1    -I"d:/RCompile/r-compiling/local/local320/include"     -O2 -Wall  -mtune=core2 -c P1_cjs.cpp -o P1_cjs.o
In file included from P1_cjs.cpp:4:0:
P1_cjs.h:3:27: fatal error: nimble/NimArr.h: No such file or directory
compilation terminated.
make: *** [P1_cjs.o] Error 1
Warning message:
l'exécution de la commande 'make -f "Makevars.win" -f "C:/PROGRA~1/R/R-32~1.2/etc/x64/Makeconf" -f "C:/PROGRA~1/R/R-32~1.2/share/make/winshlib.mk" SHLIB_LDFLAGS='$(SHLIB_CXXLDFLAGS)' SHLIB_LD='$(SHLIB_CXXLD)' SHLIB="P1_cjs09_09_17_31_29.dll" PKG_LIBS='C:/Program C:/Program C:/Program C:/Program C:/Program C:/Program C:/Program' WIN=64 TCLBIN=64 OBJECTS="P1_cjs.o P1_cjs_nfCode.o Files/R/R-3.2.1patched/library/nimble/CppCode/RcppUtils.o Files/R/R-3.2.1patched/library/nimble/CppCode/Utils.o Files/R/R-3.2.1patched/library/nimble/CppCode/NamedObjects.o Files/R/R-3.2.1patched/library/nimble/CppCode/ModelClassUtils.o Files/R/R-3.2.1patched/library/nimble/CppCode/accessorClasses.o Files/R/R-3.2.1patched/library/nimble/CppCode/dists.o Files/R/R-3.2.1patched/library/nimble/CppCode/nimDists.o"' renvoie un statut 2
Erreur : Failed to create the shared library
 Warning message:
l'exécution de la commande 'R CMD SHLIB P1_cjs.cpp P1_cjs_nfCode.cpp C:/Program Files/R/R-3.2.1patched/library/nimble/CppCode/RcppUtils.cpp C:/Program Files/R/R-3.2.1patched/library/nimble/CppCode/Utils.cpp C:/Program Files/R/R-3.2.1patched/library/nimble/CppCode/NamedObjects.cpp C:/Program Files/R/R-3.2.1patched/library/nimble/CppCode/ModelClassUtils.cpp C:/Program Files/R/R-3.2.1patched/library/nimble/CppCode/accessorClasses.cpp C:/Program Files/R/R-3.2.1patched/library/nimble/CppCode/dists.cpp C:/Program Files/R/R-3.2.1patched/library/nimble/CppCode/nimDists.cpp -o P1_cjs09_09_17_31_29.dll' renvoie un statut 1.

Anyhelp will be appreciated. Thanks a lot. G.

messages.author: dd632bd3bbcdd7e9
messages.subject: Re: false path in compil step
parts:
I am not immediately sure what the problem is.  I don’t *think* it is NIMBLE but rather something in your configuration, possibly your paths.  When you updated Rtools did you check the box to update your system’s PATH variable?
Perry
